name: OpenAI Symphony
description: Watches an issue tracker such as Linear or GitHub Issues and runs a Codex agent in its own workspace for each claimed issue, for teams testing autonomous coding.

skills.name: Tracker Polling
skills.description: Polls Linear, GitHub Issues, Jira Cloud, Asana, or GitLab for candidate work that matches the configured filters and labels.

skills.name: Per-Issue Codex Workspace
skills.description: Creates a separate workspace for each claimed issue and launches Codex in App Server mode inside it with a workspace-write sandbox.

skills.name: Tracker-Native Tools
skills.description: Gives the agent tracker tools such as linear_graphql or github_api, run with host-side auth so it needs no second tracker login.

skills.name: Terminal State Cleanup
skills.description: Stops the running agent and removes its workspace when a claimed issue moves to Done, Closed, Cancelled, or Duplicate.
